claim: Patchline generates public office-hours agendas that are driven by real signals rather than guesswork: each agenda is assembled from recent reproducibility failures and active roadmap cards, time-boxed into review, triage, and planning blocks. Every failure item references a gate that actually exists, so the agenda always points contributors at reproducible work. The gate proves that each agenda failure item maps to a real gate script, that roadmap discussion items are present, and that the rendered agenda contains the mandated review, triage, and planning sections.
real_repo: patchline (self): agenda failure items validated against scripts/*-gate.sh
